rationale.purpose: Implement the approved community-mod and resource-pack layer from the user's three-video master plan without duplicate libraries, duplicate spear content or unsafe crafting ownership.
rationale.decision_source: The user approved the attached master plan and separately selected existing potion and enchanted-book resource packs. The implementation selects exact versions, sides, conservative presentation budgets and the FastWorkbench removal after static compatibility review.

introduced.summary: Install and configure the audited Major Update 4 community-content tranche.

history.summary: Pin exact community artifacts, add the two approved CIT packs and retire FastWorkbench.
Remove Rose Gold Equipment from the Major Update 4 distribution by user direction.
Remove Windy after its client-only custom particle registry crashed after dedicated-server login.
Remove Do a Barrel Roll from the managed client by direct user request

notes: Existing CreativeCore 2.12.40 and Puzzles Lib 8.1.33 satisfy the new dependency constraints.
Structory and Ocean Lily Pad Village affect new chunks only. No existing world chunk is regenerated.
The Immersive Storms port passed static side-gating review but remains a new beta without runtime acceptance.
The TreeChop Windows Internet Shortcut is not a runtime artifact and is excluded from managed transfer. The real client and server JARs remain identical.
unresolved: Minecraft launch and player acceptance were not performed.
Shader, multi-pane Weather Glass and fresh-chunk worldgen acceptance remain pending.
The custom mechanics from later master-plan phases are separate implementation work.
